decisions.reason: The cleaning soap gained its own page in 2024, which signals results at or above aspiration, and it extends the established care range at low cost.
The maintenance oil line remains visible and complements the oiled floor business; with industry growth and slack there is no shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of the resources.
The care product line was promoted to its own page in 2024, which suggests it meets aspirations, and it supports retention of customers with oiled floors.
The moisture-protection underlay is a low-cost accessory that fits the flooring system; continued listing and growing demand give no reason for problemistic search.
The high-density foam underlay is still listed and adds to the accessory range, though it may overlap with Product D; the firm's slack allows it to carry the product while results are uncertain.
The oak parquet line is close to the core business and uses existing production and sales capabilities, so performance is likely near aspiration in a growing market.
